name: qkd_pv_fin_s8_pin
purpose: KV-PVFIN-1 2026-11-13 (R-CAP-3.3, DIE-KV-100 06:13 ASK, kv3_hub_C split): ONE lane slice of the PV final join qkd_pv_fin_s: 8 of its 16 fp32 lanes (256-b beats), the whole static-calendar control replicated per slice; two instances (pvfin_lo lanes 0-7, pvfin_hi lanes 8-15) replace the 273k-cell soft qkd_pv_fin_s in kv3_hub_C (drop-in pair qkd_pv_fin_s2x8). Faces per the hub_C split plan (KV-HUBC-REACH gen_pvfin_pins.py): W = operand inputs p0 / rz / p1, E = out / fault / control / ck / rst_n, N / S free (the two slices abut N-S). +1 added cycle (declared, results/kv-pvfin-1/latency_rows.json): every input lands in a pin flop (stage i) ahead of the pin registers of qkd_pv_fin_s, every output a flop, beat b = PRODUCT_AGE + 2 + b (qkd_pv_fin_s: + 1 + b).

job.purpose: KV-PVFIN-1 11-13: lane-sliced pv_fin hard core qkd_pv_fin_s8_pin (2 per kv3_hub_C) for the R-CAP-3 hub_C split.

pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers every input at the pin (control *_q, data = tap 0 of the operand lines) and every output is a flop; the static calendar {R, P1, P0} and the face's F_DLY count that one pin stage (bench tb_qkd_pv_fin_s2x8 lock-step vs qkd_pv_fin_s: beat b = reference + 1 + b); a flow-inserted second stage would add an edge the calendar does not have. io_flop_at_pins anchors the RTL pin flops (recipe 2/3).

structural_change: KV-PVFIN-1 11-13: new core (lane slice of qkd_pv_fin_s). The unsliced pvfin_h3 build (epyc7 kvhubc-core1, 11-12) failed post-place setup -448 ps / CTS -381 ps on out_epoch[3] and ~20k endpoints: the calendar slots were 16-bit window compares of age + 1 against adder-derived ages, ANDed into the fault check, the state enables and the 16,384 sbuf enables, and the multiplier operands came through a 32:1 read mux. R-RTL-5 (1)+(2)+(3): calendar decoded flop to flop behind a +1 input stage (s8c: the raw-pin decode sat behind the 487 ps link-budget input delay, post-CTS -304 ps at cq_bad / cq_em), out_beat / out_epoch enabled without the fault cone, sbuf a flat vector (s8a: an inferred memory moved the 32:1 read mux behind the address flop, -480 ps), slots are flag registers (set/clear by equality), beat indices are 5-bit counters, the sbuf read and head select are prefetched one edge early into operand registers with a write-through bypass. Outline 207.36 W x 194.4 H (R-CAP-2: 17.7k um2 std after place / ~38.7k um2 core = ~0.46; the planned 190.08 frame would sit at ~0.51). Height 194.4 so the abutted lo/hi pair (388.8, origins (1041.12, 851.04) / (1041.12, 1045.44)) passes hubc_split_form.py --cores: the hub_C pocket is bounded by ft21 (y 839.3) and the reset local tap (1218.24, 1252.8) with 10.8 um clearance, ft0 (x 1029.8) and clk_t44 (x 1260); the 207.36-square s8d build (signed off) did not fit.
